questions.q: A question says « Explique con sus propias palabras… ». What must you do?
options: Copy the sentence that contains the answer
Paraphrase the idea without copying it
Give your own opinion of the text
Quote and name the literary device
questions.why: Own words prove understanding; copying usually earns nothing.

questions.q: Text: «Al ver la carta, a Elena se le hizo un nudo en la garganta.» What does this suggest?
options: Se emocionó y estaba a punto de llorar
Le dolía la garganta por un resfriado
Se enfadó y empezó a gritar
questions.why: It is a figurative expression for a sudden strong emotion, not a literal throat problem.

questions.q: A comprehension question is worth [2]. What does this usually require?
options: A long quotation from the text
questions.why: Look at the marks: [2] usually means two different ideas, not the same one repeated.

questions.q: Text: «El camarero le sirvió su café de siempre sin preguntarle nada.» What does this suggest about the customer? Answer in Spanish.
questions.model: Que es un cliente habitual / va a menudo, porque el camarero ya sabe lo que toma sin preguntar.
points: evidence: el camarero ya sabe lo que pide
